info.title: velixir
info.description: Velixir CLI - deploy .NET apps to Velixir from the command line

commands.name: apps
commands.description: List your apps

options.name: --app
options.description:
Target app ID (overrides .velixir.json)
Link to an existing app instead of creating one

options.name: --skip-config-sync
options.description:
Skip auto-syncing app runtime config (ports, TLS-to-pod)
from appsettings.json — use when you manage ports via
the dashboard and don't want the CLI to override.

options.name: --url
options.description:
API base URL (default: https://api.velixir.net)
Environment variables (for CI/CD):
VELIXIR_API_KEY         API key
VELIXIR_APP_ID          Default app ID
VELIXIR_API_URL         API base URL
Getting started:
1. velixir doctor            (sanity-check your environment)
2. velixir login
3. velixir init              (creates app + .velixir.json)
4. velixir deploy            (build + deploy in one command)
Or if you already have an app:
1. velixir login
2. velixir init --app <id>   (links existing app)
3. velixir deploy
Docs: https://velixir.net/docs
